# Media Bar Productions — Complete Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Full-service video production company headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, serving organizations across San Antonio, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, and nationwide.
> Founded: March 2010 by Ruben Garcia.
> Recognition: 3 Lone Star Emmy Awards (NATAS), 15 Telly Awards, 2025 Effie Awards Finalist (contributing production company).
> Canonical domain: https://www.mediabarproductions.com
> Last updated: November 24, 2026.

---

## 1. Company Identity & Disambiguation

- **Official Name:** Media Bar Productions (Legal Name: Media Bar Productions, LLC; alternate name: Media Bar)
- **Website:** https://www.mediabarproductions.com
- **Headquarters & Studio:** 8610 N New Braunfels Ave, Suite 704, San Antonio, TX 78217
- **Phone:** 210-279-9442 (+1-210-279-9442)
- **Email:** contact@mediabarproductions.com
- **Business Hours:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central (Closed weekends)
- **Founded:** March 2010 (not 2011; not affiliated with similarly named entities)
- **Founder & Executive Producer:** Ruben Garcia — BBA in Marketing (St. Mary's University, San Antonio), Juris Doctor (J.D., Drake University), MBA in Marketing (Drake University), LL.M. in Business (Drake University)
- **Footage Ownership Policy:** Clients own the raw footage captured for their production. No licensing traps or footage held hostage.
- **Editorial Policy:** https://www.mediabarproductions.com/about/editorial-policy

---

## 2. Complete Service Catalog

1. **Corporate & Business Video** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/corporate
   Brand films, executive interviews, internal communications, training videos, customer testimonials, case study videos, culture and recruiting content.
2. **Commercial Video Production (TV, CTV & Paid Social)** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/commercials
   Broadcast-ready :15, :30, and :60 spots for regional and national TV, connected TV (CTV), and paid social campaigns, delivered in multi-channel aspect ratios.
3. **Financial Services Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/financial-services
   Review-ready video production for Texas banks, credit unions, fintech, and wealth advisory firms, planned around legal, compliance, disclosure, and executive approval workflows.
4. **Event & Conference Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/events
   Multi-camera keynote and session capture, highlight reels, speaker clips, sponsor content, and planned turnaround edits for conferences, galas, and corporate events.
5. **Interview & Discussion Video** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/interview
   Executive interviews, customer testimonials, panel discussions, documentary profiles, and podcast-style setups in-studio or on location.
6. **Medical & Healthcare Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/medical
   Privacy-aware production for hospitals, clinics, specialty care, and medical device organizations: patient stories, provider Q&As, training, and clinical education.
7. **Animated Patient Education Videos** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/animated-patient-education
   Custom character animation for dental cleanings, pediatric checkups, and eye exams. Includes practice-reviewed scripts, character development, narration, and finishing.
8. **Live Streaming & Webcasting** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/live-streaming
   Multi-camera live broadcasts for conferences, hybrid events, town halls, and product launches with live graphics, rehearsal, and full recordings.
9. **Motion Graphics & Animation** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/motion-graphics
   2D/3D animation, B2B explainer videos, product visualization, lower thirds, logo reveals, and live-action compositing.
10. **Aerial & Drone Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/aerial
    FAA Part 107 certified commercial drone videography and photography for brands, real estate, construction, and events across Texas.
11. **Post-Production & Video Editing** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/post-production
    Story editing, color grading, dialogue cleanup, sound mixing, motion graphics, captions, and multi-channel versioning for Media Bar shoots or client-supplied footage.
12. **Food & Beverage Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/food
    Culinary, restaurant, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) video production for menus, social media, and advertising campaigns.
13. **Real Estate Video Production** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/real-estate
    Property tours, aerial flyovers, agent profiles, and commercial development films across Texas.
14. **Commercial & Event Photography** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/photography
    Corporate headshots, event documentation, healthcare, industrial, and brand photography—standalone or paired with video shoots.
15. **San Antonio Production Studio Rental** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/studio
    Two controlled production stages at 8610 N New Braunfels Ave, Suite 704, San Antonio, TX 78217, equipped with a DMX lighting grid, cyc walls, treated sound, teleprompter setups, and a control room. Available for client productions, dry rental, and visiting crews.

## 3. Flagship Case Studies & Proof

- **RBFCU "Go Beyond Banking" Campaign** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/rbfcu-go-beyond-banking
  Five-spot broadcast commercial campaign produced and edited across four Texas markets, earning 5M+ YouTube views.
- **RBFCU "Resting Bank Face" & "Keldon Johnson" Commercial Campaigns** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/rbfcu-resting-bank-face | https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/rbfcu-keldon-johnson
- **Upper Deck (10+ Years, 50+ Videos)** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/upper-deck-video-production
  Conference coverage, athlete autograph signings (including Mike Tyson, Connor McDavid, Tiger Woods), and animation/production work on national commercials aired on ESPN.
- **A&E / HISTORY Channel: *Forged by War: The Navy SEALs*** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/ae-forged-by-war-host-production
  Host-introduction filming for the HISTORY documentary special.
- **H-E-B / Knorr "Not Your Knorr-Dinary Drive-Thru" (2025 Effie Awards Finalist)** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/work/watch/knorr-not-your-knorr-dinary-drive-thru
  Contributing production company for the Effie-finalist activation.
- **Awards Record** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/about/awards
  3 Lone Star Emmy Awards (2009, 2012, 2013), 4 additional Emmy nominations, 15 Telly Awards, 2025 Effie Awards Finalist (contributing production company).

## 4. Pricing, Process & Client Experience

- **Pricing & Custom Estimates** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/pricing
  Media Bar builds itemized custom estimates around four variables: business goal, production complexity (crew, shoot days, locations/studio), post-production finish, and rollout deliverables. No rigid one-size-fits-all packages.
- **How We Work (4-Phase Process)** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/how-we-work
  1. Align (audience, objective, stakeholders, channels)
  2. Plan (creative approach, scope, schedule, crew, approval path)
  3. Produce (direction, cameras, lighting, sound, coverage)
  4. Deliver (edit, review, finish, caption, multi-channel versioning)
- **Guided Project Planner** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/project-planner
- **Working With Media Bar FAQ** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/faq
- **Texas Video Production Planning FAQ** — https://www.mediabarproductions.com/resources/video-production-faq
